workarounds.symptom: pr-agent v0.48.0: **GitLab webhooks backed by a secret provider need a new token format** ([#3913](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3913)): when GitLab credentials come from AWS Secrets
workarounds.workaround: Fix: **GitLab webhooks backed by a secret provider need a new token format** ([#3913](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3913)): when GitLab credentials come from AWS Secrets Manager or Google Cloud Storage, the webhook's Secret Token must be `<secret-name>:<webhook-token>`. Name-only tokens are rejected with HTTP 401, so update the webhooks when you deploy.. Upstream PR #3913. (Ref: https://github.com/Codium-ai/pr-agent/pull/3913)

workarounds.symptom: pr-agent v0.48.0: **Azure DevOps and Bitbucket Server webhooks require credentials** ([#3911](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3911)): with `azure_devops_server.webhook_username`/`webho
workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Azure DevOps and Bitbucket Server webhooks require credentials** ([#3911](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3911)): with `azure_devops_server.webhook_username`/`webhook_password` or `bitbucket_server.webhook_secret` unset, every webhook is rejected with HTTP 403. Set them on both the sender and PR-Agent before upgrading.. Upstream PR #3911. (Ref: https://github.com/Codium-ai/pr-agent/pull/3911)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Smaller behaviour changes**: webhook servers reject request bodies over 5 MiB with HTTP 413 (`config.max_webhook_request_body_bytes`, [#3820](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3820)).
